chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Isa from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Hammad from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
When the Muhrim (person in Ihram) catches the game, he is not permitted to flee in the first flight, and whoever flees in the first flight is not permitted to take the game until the people flee.
So whoever hastens within two days - there is no sin upon him for whoever fears [God].

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمُ: The pilgrim in the state of Ihram

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a pilgrim in Ihram who catches game accidentally?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi records this ruling in *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, clarifying the procedural penalty for a Muhrim who accidentally catches game by requiring him to wait for the general flight of people before retrieving it. The hadith provides a specific Shia exegetical interpretation of the phrase 'those who fear' in the Quranic verse, identifying the 'fear' as the fear of the game fleeing, thereby linking the legal condition directly to the Quranic text.
